name: mc-assets
description: Minecraft assets every film shares: the props pack (pack/assets/gohans, pack.ts) and what makes props work (gamefont, ink, screen, variants for the studio), the game's own open air read from the jar for outdoor sets: biome colours and weather, clouds, still water and lava (environment), the sky and fog for a film's composer (sky), the game's particles and the events that throw them, block breaks, explosions, fireworks, torches, mob deaths (particles), rain and snow with their ground splashes (weather), the first-person underwater and burning overlays (screen-effects), block-model-renderer's runtime files (vendor.mjs, a film's postinstall), blocks cherry-picked from the vault's mod packs (pick.mjs; pick.py forwards here), what the creator drops into a scene from the studio (placed). MineRender's mob dataset mirrored into the vault (mobs.ts, for mc-actor/mob). The game itself, the rig and the clips stay in the vault (vault.json, bun run link).
